reference_note: 레퍼런스 출처: Zack D. Films 영상 스타일 (사용자 확인). 이 필드는 기록용이며 생성 프롬프트에는 들어가지 않는다 — system_name은 관찰 기반 서술 이름을 쓴다.
surface: seamless sky-blue studio cyclorama with a soft vertical gradient, no horizon or corners
type_specimen: H1 sample "IF YOU SWALLOW THIS" in heavy rounded sans caps with a thick dark outline; a caption sample "natural oils" in the same face, smaller, pinned to the lower third
color_rules: Cyclorama Blue is background only and never touches a subject; Caption White is type only; skin tones carry the midground
components: a smooth-skinned 3D figure, centred to camera
a skin macro with visible pores and vellus hairs
a cutaway of skin layers with follicles, in wet pinks
a pair of hands entering frame to hold a prop
a plain everyday prop at real scale
a heavy white caption block with a dark outline
construction_logic: soft-lit 3D renders, smooth subsurface skin, rounded simplified anatomy, shallow macro depth of field
mini_scenes: a figure centred on the cyclorama mid-reaction, caption across the lower third
a skin macro with one insect standing among the pores
a cutaway of skin layers with follicles descending
motion_signature: slow push-in on a reacting face
macro drift across a skin surface
a cutaway peels open to the layer beneath
a prop drops in and settles
stage: the persistent background world every clip lives on - a seamless sky-blue cyclorama, softly graded, evenly lit, empty and ready for figures and props to enter

confidence.palette: high — extract_palette.py 실측. 살색 3단계 중 2개만 채택, 하늘색 2단계는 그라데이션으로 병합, 그림자색은 Hair Umber에 흡수
confidence.stage: medium-high — 13장 중 9장에서 동일 배경. 나머지는 매크로라 배경이 화면 밖
confidence.type_specimen: high — 실제 관찰된 자막 문구 사용
